svg.title: UbuKit — Library overview
svg.desc: A Python and JavaScript library for clustering, self-organizing maps, evaluation, and hyperparameter search. Data flows through language-specific interfaces into models, results, and metrics. Adjusted Rand index and adjusted mutual information compare cluster labels; trustworthiness and continuity assess neighborhood preservation. Evaluation scores feed UbuKit's lightweight Tree-structured Parzen estimator or random search. CPU execution is the main foundation. GPU paths are optional experimental research.

g.text: Clustering, self-organizing maps, evaluation, and parameter search
One workflow in Python and JavaScript
